name: Blood
look: Blood shield from dark cultivation fantasy. A thin dark crimson film shaped like a tall dome surrounds the character, veins of bright red flowing through it.
subject: shield

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: blood rises from the ground in streams and spreads into the dome

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the film holds, red veins flowing slowly across it and droplets sliding down; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes from the right; the film bulges inward at the impact point and droplets splatter out to the right

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the film loses its shape and drains down into the ground as dripping streams
